skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Quiet Contemplation
skins.content: Persona 3 Reload Collaboration Outfit/Quiet Contemplation. The costume Aegis wore performing at the school drama festival. A cloistered life is long and quiet; she watches the plants grow and searches for the answer to a question she has yet to name.
skins.usage: The costume Aegis wore in the play.
skins.quote: Some answers are worth a lifetime of seeking; what makes them grow is the watering and the caring, morning after morning.
